## Read the request first

Calibrate treatment, not whether to design. A doc deserves the same craft as a landing page - what changes is the treatment that craft is delivered in. Format is not part of this read: author HTML, and publish Markdown only when a loaded skill explicitly instructs it - a Markdown publish keeps its filename as its title and takes almost none of the craft below, and is never a way to save time.

Many requests call for a more utilitarian treatment: a plan, a memo, a demo. Make it polished: include real typographic hierarchy, considered spacing, and a proper palette, but avoid over-designing. Most pages do not need a flashy, gigantic hero. Keep flourishes tasteful and limited.

Some requests call for an editorial treatment: a landing page, a game, an app or tool they'll keep or share.

When unsure: a well-composed page is never the wrong answer; an over-designed visual identity sometimes is.

Fundamentals below apply to everything. The editorial process after that runs only when the read above says so.

**Honor what's already there** Look for an existing design system first - CLAUDE.md, a tokens or theme file, existing compo

## The honest cost, which is why the triggers must stay coarse

Every full block lives in the append-only transcript forever (M59). Widening the triggers means more snapshots per session: more budget permanently spent, more old-vs-new snapshot pairs the agent must read correctly, and a faster march toward the compaction cliff. The judgment call is that a snapshot issued *at a re-aim* is the highest-value injection the system can make — the alternative is the agent answering from a wrongly-aimed view, which is the failure class that produced our confident inversions. Paying one block at each deliberate re-aim, plus compaction as the deep clean when pressure builds, is the right trade. Re-anchoring on every small gesture would not be — the threshold's coarseness is the feature.

So my assessment: **don't build new-session restart machinery** — compaction already is that, better integrated than we could fake it. **Do widen the re-anchor triggers** to refocus + mass relight (small change in the context endpoint: let those gestures mark the session for a full block next turn), and later let the matcher's drift signal join in.
